668S / 668GTS: Cortech Endurance Cylinder Base Molded Table with Round Top
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-668-endurance-42-cylinder-base-table
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/endurance-round-base-table/
Spec sheets: 668S / 668GTS, Assembly, Ballasting
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Cylinder Base Molded Table with Round Top – 668S / 668GTS
Current H1: Cortech Endurance 42" Round Top Table - Molded Cylinder Base and Molded Top - Model 668S
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded 42” Round Table on a Cylinder Base for Dining Rooms and Dayrooms
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 668S Endurance Table with Cylinder Base and Laminate Top / 668GTS Game Top Table
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Cylinder Base Molded Table with Round Top is a fully molded 42” round table for dining rooms, dayrooms, and activity rooms in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. The top and cylinder base are rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, and the rounded edge of the top adds safety and comfort.
The base attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws, and the table can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes with the Cortech Sabre Mount System. An optional ballast door lets you add weight with sandbags. It comes with a plain top or a game top, pairs with the Cortech RazorBack Chair, and is rated for outdoor use.
Material: Top and base rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene with an antimicrobial compound
Base: Molded cylinder base; attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws
Top Size: 42” round, with a rounded edge
Dimensions: 42”W×42”D×29”H
Weight: 38 lbs (top 22 lbs, base 16 lbs)
Game Top: Optional game top with a checkerboard pattern
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
668S – 42” Round, Plain Top: 38 lbs
668GTS – 42” Round, Game Top: 38 lbs
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes with the Sabre Mount System
Ballast: Optional ballast door for adding weight with sandbags (T27 bit); Cortech says not to use loose sand
Assembly: The base attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws and washers; see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The Endurance Cylinder Base Table suits dining rooms, dayrooms, and activity rooms where a table has to stand up to hard daily use and frequent cleaning.
Typical applications include:
Dining rooms and dayrooms in correctional facilities and jails
Behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and activity rooms
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (53 characters): Cortech Endurance Cylinder Base Table - 668S / 668GTS
Meta description (154 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance cylinder base molded table. A fully molded 42 inch round table with plain or game top, rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: your current H1 lists only the 668S. I named the cylinder base, the same way as the X-base table pages, and added both model numbers.
Subtitle: your current subtitle says "Laminate Top," but this is the fully molded table. Cortech sells the laminate top version separately.
Model numbers: the Cortech spec sheet lists 668 (plain top) and 668GT (game top). Cortech photo names use 668S and 668GTS, the same as your variants, so I kept yours.
Variant names: your variants say "Solid Top." The Cortech spec sheet says "Plain Top," the same as on the Norix table pages. Would you like them renamed, for example "668S - Plain Top"?
Weight: both variants are set to 255 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 38 lbs (top 22 lbs, base 16 lbs), so I used 38 lbs for both.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year factory warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. Cortech now lists 18, adding Canvas, Claylight, Moss, Overcast, Seagrass, and Tide. I used the Cortech list.
Ballast: your current page says the base can be filled with sand. Cortech now says to add weight with sandbags through an optional ballast door and not to use loose sand, so I used that.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says fully molded tables are rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has five images. The last one is a color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Does the chart show all 18?
